results.title: The matte 144 Hz IPS display of the Asus ExpertBook PM5 G2 is perfect for work
results.description: While some manufacturers only equip their business laptops with pretty weak IPS panels, Asus equips its new ExpertBook PM5 G2 with a high-resolution WQHD IPS panel with a frequency of 144 Hz, which is ideal for productive tasks.
